# sendio_segment (Resource)

A segment: a static list of contacts that broadcasts can target. Destroying it keeps the contacts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendio_segment" "customers" {
  name = "Customers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Segment name. Renaming updates it in place.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the segment was created.
- `id` (String) Segment id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sendio_segment.customers 3a7c9e10-1b2d-4f3e-8a5c-6d7e8f901234
```
